counterexample: Tick spacing 10. One position [100, 200), so ticks 100 and 200 are initialized. initDown with start 100 and end 50 builds a fresh struct whose currentTick and currentWord are 0, so wasReused is false and the search begins strictly below 100. The walk returns nothing; it should return [100]. The hook's first walk, in CompensationPriceFinder.getZeroForOne, always uses such a fresh iterator. A reused iterator whose last walk stopped at tick 0 with an empty word is also treated as fresh.
summary: Sets the current tick to the start plus one only when the start is a multiple of the tick spacing and the iterator already held a non-zero tick or word before reset. The first walk after initDown still skips the start tick, so the price finder and the reward walk see different ticks, and attacks P2, P4 and P5 still work.
